args.title: Fix weekly scheduled exports skipping the first run
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

In `nextRunAt`, the "weekly" branch always advances the date by 7 days, unlike "daily" which only advances when the computed run time has already passed (`next <= from`). This means a weekly schedule created before `RUN_HOUR_UTC` on its run day unconditionally skips that day's run and jumps a full week ahead, even though the run time hasn't occurred yet. This matches the reported behavior: a schedule created at 05:40 UTC (before the 06:00 UTC run hour) sent nothing until the following week, while one created at 09:00 (after the run hour) worked as expected.

Propose changing the "weekly" case to mirror "daily": only add 7 days when `next <= from`, otherwise leave `next` as the computed same-day run time. This ensures a weekly schedule created before the daily run hour still fires on its intended first day instead of skipping to the following week.
